reference_role: Existing Little Bird exact identity and thin-outline style target
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent animation key-pose sheet editing the existing Little Bird character in the reference PNG, not a new character.
Create ONE square transparent PNG containing exactly FOUR equal square cells in a precise 2 by 2 layout, with NO borders or labels. Reference image is the exact identity and drawing style target. Preserve the pale golden-yellow gouache/paper texture, thin textured warm-brown outline, one solid brown dot eye with no white highlight, tiny flat oval beak, rounded continuous head/body, one upturned tail, and two simple peach feet. No blush, no clothes, no accessories, no white highlights, no feathers/fingers added. Match the reference's THIN outline, do not thicken the outlines.
Registration is essential: every cell represents the same square reference canvas scaled uniformly. The usual standing bird has its head top near 27 percent of cell height, feet touching the imaginary ground at 77 percent height, and foot-center near 51 percent cell width; its normal body/head silhouette height excluding raised wing is about 50 percent of the cell. Keep the body/head/eye/beak size and foot spacing consistent in all cells; no per-pose zoom. Generous transparent padding. Feet stay at the same ground line in all four cells.
TOP LEFT: same LEFT-facing bird, feet planted, ONLY its near wing half raised diagonally upward and forward, head/body/eye/beak/feet exactly as the reference standing pose.
TOP RIGHT: same LEFT-facing bird, feet planted, ONLY its near wing fully raised in a small friendly flutter, head/body/eye/beak/feet exactly as the reference standing pose. Rounded simple yellow wing, no human arm, no fingers.
BOTTOM LEFT: intermediate peck motion: same bird bends its compact head and front body halfway down toward the ground to the LEFT of its planted feet, tail rises slightly; eye stays on the visible side. Make this a natural small bird bending, not a rotated rigid sticker and not a long neck.
BOTTOM RIGHT: full peck: compact bird bent down so the tip of its small beak points down and actually meets the SAME imaginary ground line at 77 percent cell height, a short distance LEFT of its planted feet; tail up, round body and natural balance. No worm, seeds or added object.
Transparent background in all four cells. No shadow, no floor, no scenery, no text, no symbols, no watermark. Exactly four separate complete birds, one per cell. Keep every wing, beak, tail and foot safely inside its cell. The same existing character throughout. Picture-book educational video animation, quiet gentle gestures.
adoption_note: One common body reference height378; pose feet registered to canonical foot-center, no per-pose scale fitting. Brief near-ground peck gesture; no claim of exact horizontal ground-line contact.
